UI_CONFIRM_CLEAR: Remove all buildings from the board?
UI_EMPTY_HINT: Pick a recipe on the left to place a building. Drag from a port to another port to connect them, or drop it on empty space to add a matching building.
UI_SUMMARY_EMPTY: Totals for the whole board appear here.
UI_SAVE_HINT: Learned skills and Gem Overclocker gems are read from a save file: {0}
UI_SAVE_OUT_TITLE: Write the architect's layout (buildings placed, moved or deleted, recipes, transporters, moved rocks) into a copy of {0} and download it. Replacing the file in the game's save folder is up to you: keep a backup.
UI_SAVE_OUT_DONE: {0} downloaded. Close the world in the game (main menu), back up the old file, then put this one in its place.
UI_SAVE_OUT_NOTHING: Nothing to write: the layout is the same as in the save.
UI_SAVE_OUT_MISSING: The save this board came from is no longer stored in the browser. Import it again.
UI_SAVE_NO_TEMPLATE: Your save has no building of this type yet, so it can't be written into the save. Build one in the game first.
UI_ARCH_FIXED: Part of the world: can't be moved or deleted
UI_ARCH_PREMADE: A special island: nothing can be built here
UI_FACTORY_TITLE: Put every production building from a save on the board, connect the chains and take the save's bonuses
UI_FACTORY_REPLACE: Replace the current board with the factory from this save?
UI_FACTORY_DONE: {0}, day {1}: {2} buildings on {3} islands as {4} cards, {5} connections. Not placed: {6} without a usable recipe, {7} workbenches and cloning machines.
UI_WATERED_TITLE: Renewable plants regrow without water. Watering burns water balls; fertilizer is only used up while the plant has water (unwatered, it keeps working without running out).
UI_GOAL_CUSTOM_HINT: Items you want and how often
UI_GOAL_BUILD_TITLE: Add buildings for everything missing, down to raw resources (drills, farms and creatures are left to you)
UI_GOAL_BUILT: Added {0} buildings. Left as raw resources: {1}.
UI_ENERGY_TITLE: Energy used / produced. Energy is shared within an island only.
UI_DRILL_WRONG_ISLAND: A driller on {0} can't mine this
UI_DRILL_FRAME: At most one item per frame: at 60 FPS ≈{0} per driller
UI_SUMMARY_FOCUS: Click to show the buildings that make or use it
UI_MODE_ARCH_TITLE: Islands and buildings laid out as in the game
UI_ISLAND_DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete {0}? Its cards stay on the board without an island; the buildings placed on it are removed.
UI_ISLAND_RENAME_TITLE: Drag to move, double-click to rename
UI_ARCH_HINT: Click an empty hexagon to add an island. Pick a building on the left, then click on an island to place it (Shift: keep placing, Esc or right click: stop). Drag buildings to move them; Delete removes the selected one, double click opens its card.
UI_EDGE_NO_TRANSPORT: No transporter or drone carries {0} from {1} to {2}
UI_VIEW_CHAIN_TITLE: One production chain, islands not separated
UI_DRONE_PICK_HINT: Click a deposit on any island to deliver to it (Esc cancels)
UI_DRONE_BAD_TARGET: Drones deliver only to deposits, other drone bases, item antennas and export rockets
UI_MAGNET_PICK_TITLE: Link this building to a touching one: a magnetoid moves items from this one to the other
UI_MAGNET_PICK_HINT: Click the touching building that receives the items (Esc cancels)
UI_MAGNET_NO_PAIR: These buildings don't touch through free magnetoid slots
UI_MAGNET_NO_ANTENNA: This island needs a Magnetoid Antenna first
